Results you save from the CargoKit tools appear here. They are kept on this phone only.
Where are my saved results kept?
Only on this phone or browser. Nothing is uploaded to our servers, so clearing the app data or browser data removes them.
Can I save a result from any tool?
Use the Share / Save button that appears under a result in the CBM calculator, import duty calculator, HSN code finder and container number checker.
Are saved results updated when duty rates change?
No. A saved result is a snapshot with the date it was made. Open the tool again for the current figures.
Want a licensed broker to check a saved result before you ship?
Run a calculation, tap Share / Save under the result, then Save to My saved. It will show up here.
